meaning_of_independent: This author solved the source before reading any alternatives, author key, candidate, answer material or prior review. This is not an independent reviewer, SCI approval, semantic gate or completed choice set.

historical_definition.basis: Definition paragraph 0 gives p = (1/3) m n overline(v^2). Paragraph 1 calls the last factor 均方速度. Thus the supplied historical term denotes the mean of squared molecular speeds, not sqrt(overline(v^2)).
historical_definition.consequence: Task 4 uses a quantity proportional to absolute temperature, not its square root. The original wording is retained; no erratum is inferred.

tasks.source_text: 大气中哪种分子运动得较快：氢分子或氮分子？
tasks.learner_task: Compare the characteristic molecular motion of atmospheric hydrogen molecules and nitrogen molecules.
conditions: The species are H2 and N2, compared locally at the same absolute temperature in thermal equilibrium.
Use classical translational equipartition, m overline(v^2) = 3 k_B T. Equal temperature, not equal mass or equal speed, gives equal mean translational kinetic energy.
Approximate ordinary molecular molar masses as M(H2) = 2 g/mol and M(N2) = 28 g/mol only to illustrate ratios; the lighter-molecule conclusion does not require these rounded numerical masses.
derivation: For each species, overline(v^2) = 3 k_B T/m = 3 R T/M.
Therefore overline(v_H2^2)/overline(v_N2^2) = (T_H2/T_N2) M_N2/M_H2.
At the same T, this is approximately 28/2 = 14. Hydrogen has the larger mean square speed.
The corresponding characteristic speed scale sqrt(overline(v^2)) has ratio sqrt(14) = 3.7416573867739413; this square root is a separately named comparison, not a redefinition of 均方速度.
At equal T, any consistently chosen classical Maxwell speed statistic, such as mean speed or rms speed, scales as M^(-1/2), so the qualitative hydrogen-before-nitrogen ordering is unchanged.

invariant_vs_assumption.invariant_under_choice_of_characteristic: Hydrogen has the larger characteristic motion scale.
invariant_vs_assumption.extra_assumption: The source does not explicitly state equal temperatures. Local atmospheric thermal equilibrium supplies that customary condition; it is not a verbatim source fact.
invariant_vs_assumption.without_common_T: No unconditional ordering follows. Hydrogen has larger mean square speed exactly when T_H2/T_N2 > M_H2/M_N2, approximately 1/14. Equality gives equal values.
invariant_vs_assumption.not_claimed: Not every hydrogen molecule is faster than every nitrogen molecule; molecular velocity distributions overlap.

source_ambiguities: The qualitative word 较快 does not specify a statistical measure. Under the stated common-temperature model the species ordering is invariant, but a numerical speed ratio requires naming the measure.

tasks.source_text: 在标准大气压和温度为 $20^\circ\mathrm{C}$ 时，体积为 $50$ 米$^3$ 的房间中和盛有 $200$ 厘米$^3$ 水的玻璃杯中，哪里分子较多？
tasks.learner_task: Compare total molecule counts in 50 m^3 of room air and 200 cm^3 of liquid water, rather than comparing only volume or number density.
conditions: Treat the room volume as 50 m^3 of ideal-gas air at p = 101325 Pa and T = 293.15 K.
Treat the cup contents as liquid water, with approximate density rho = 1000 kg/m^3 and molecular molar mass M = 0.018 kg/mol.
The density and molar mass are declared classroom approximations, not values given by the two supplied definition paragraphs. No ideal-gas model is applied to liquid water.
Count air molecules in the room and water molecules in the stated liquid, excluding the container, room walls, nonwater solutes and any extraneous air above the water.
derivation: Standard atmosphere is p = 101325 N/m^2. Absolute temperature is 20 + 273.15 = 293.15 K.
Combine p = (1/3) m n_density overline(v^2) with m overline(v^2) = 3 k_B T: p = n_density k_B T. For N_air = n_density V_air, N_air = p V_air/(k_B T).
N_air = 1.2517379968237164e27 molecules, or approximately 1.25e27.
m_water = rho V_water = (1000 kg/m^3)(2e-4 m^3) = 0.200 kg.
nu_water = m_water/M_water = 0.200 kg/(0.018 kg/mol) = 11.111111111111112 mol.
N_water = nu_water N_A = 6.691267511111112e24 molecules, or approximately 6.69e24.
N_air/N_water = 187.07038610325418, or approximately 1.9e2. Thus the room air contains many more molecules despite the much greater molecular number density of liquid water.

invariant_vs_assumption.model_conditional_comparison: The room-air count is larger using the declared physical models; the conclusion is not a comparison of volume alone.
invariant_vs_assumption.robustness: With p, T, volumes and M as above, equal counts would require rho_water = p V_air M/(R T V_water) = 187070.38610325422 kg/m^3. Ordinary liquid-water density modeled near 1000 kg/m^3 is far below this threshold, so ordinary density or textbook rounding changes cannot reverse the comparison.
invariant_vs_assumption.not_exact_source_determined_counts: The source does not specify water density, molecular molar mass, gas nonideality or measurement tolerances. The displayed long decimal values are calculation checkpoints, not experimental precision.
invariant_vs_assumption.air_composition: Ideal-gas total molecular count at fixed p, V and T does not require an assumed average molar mass for air.

source_ambiguities: The quantities needed for a numerical count include material constants not printed in the allowed source. The customary ideal-air and liquid-water approximations are explicit rather than attributed to the source.
No water-temperature-dependent density table is authorized or consulted; rho = 1000 kg/m^3 is used as an approximation.

tasks.source_text: 当温度从 $37^\circ\mathrm{C}$ 升高到 $40^\circ\mathrm{C}$ 时，我们血液中水分子的均方速度增加百分之几？
tasks.learner_task: Calculate the percentage increase of the mean square speed of water molecules using absolute temperature and the supplied historical terminology.
conditions: Preserve 均方速度 as overline(v^2), with unit m^2/s^2.
Compare the same water molecular species in local classical thermal equilibrium before and after heating.
Classical translational equipartition gives overline(v^2) = 3 k_B T/m. This is a thermal velocity model for the liquid molecules, not an ideal-gas pressure equation applied to blood.
derivation: For the same molecular mass, overline(v_final^2)/overline(v_initial^2) = T_final/T_initial = 313.15/310.15 = 1.0096727389972593.
Percentage increase = [overline(v_final^2) - overline(v_initial^2)]/overline(v_initial^2) * 100% = (313.15 - 310.15)/310.15 * 100% = 3/310.15 * 100%.
This is 0.9672738997259391%, approximately 0.97%. The initial absolute temperature is the denominator.
Using the explicitly rounded school offset 273 K instead gives 3/310 * 100% = 0.967741935483871%, which rounds to the same 0.97%.

invariant_vs_assumption.mass_and_constants_cancel: No numerical molecular mass, k_B or R is needed for the percentage.
invariant_vs_assumption.historical_definition_not_optional: The square-root scaling of rms speed would answer a different quantity. It is not substituted for the supplied definition.
invariant_vs_assumption.physical_model_assumption: Classical translational equilibrium is declared. The supplied pressure paragraphs alone do not state equipartition or define liquid-water temperature dependence.

tasks.source_text: 近代真空泵可以把压强降低到 $1.3\times10^{-10}$ 牛顿/米$^2$≈$10^{-12}$ 毫米高水银柱。在这个压强和温度为 $27^\circ\mathrm{C}$ 时，$1$ 厘米$^3$ 中含有多少气体分子？
tasks.learner_task: Determine the expected total number of gas molecules in 1 cm^3 at the given low pressure and temperature.
conditions: Use the stated SI pressure p = 1.3e-10 N/m^2 = 1.3e-10 Pa as the numerical input.
The mercury-column value is explicitly approximate in the source, not a second exact independent constraint.
Treat the residual gas as an ideal gas in local classical thermal equilibrium. No gas molecular mass is required.
derivation: From p = (1/3) m n_density overline(v^2) and m overline(v^2) = 3 k_B T, obtain p = n_density k_B T.
N = n_density V = p V/(k_B T).
Report approximately 3.1e4 molecules, consistent with the two significant digits of the pressure.
Using T = 300 K as an explicitly rounded approximation gives 31386.20556950632 molecules, with the same reported order and precision.

invariant_vs_assumption.species_independence: At fixed p, V and T under the ideal-gas model, molecular mass cancels.
invariant_vs_assumption.precision: This is an expected or macroscopic-average count, not an exact integer census of the instantaneous contents.
invariant_vs_assumption.source_pressure_rounding: Do not force the two approximate pressure spellings into exact equality or infer an erratum from their rounded equivalence.

tasks.source_text: 在压缩机的气缸中，压缩 $4$ 个摩尔的单原子理想气体。试求：如果在一个冲程中做功 $500$ 焦耳，则在这个冲程中气体的温度升高多少？假设过程是绝热的。
tasks.learner_task: Relate adiabatic compression work to the temperature increase of 4 mol of a monatomic ideal gas.
conditions: The source states a monatomic ideal gas, amount nu = 4 mol, adiabatic process, compression and work of 500 J in one stroke.
Assume the 500 J is the magnitude of net compression work actually transferred into the gas, not an unspecified gross motor-energy expenditure.
Assume the gas is a closed system with no other energy transfer or change of macroscopic kinetic or gravitational potential energy relevant to the stated thermal change.
Use classical monatomic ideal-gas internal energy U = (3/2) nu R T. Q is positive into the gas; W_by is work by the gas; W_on = -W_by.
derivation: First law with work-by convention: Delta U = Q - W_by. Equivalently, Delta U = Q + W_on.
Adiabatic means Q = 0, not Delta U = 0.
For compression work input of magnitude 500 J, W_on = +500 J and W_by = -500 J, so Delta U = +500 J.
For 4 mol of a monatomic ideal gas, Delta U = (3/2)(4 mol) R Delta T = (6 mol) R Delta T.
The total constant-volume thermal coefficient is (6 mol)(8.31446261815324 J/(mol K)) = 49.88677570891944 J/K. It is used for internal energy even though the process is not isochoric.
Delta T = 500 J/(49.88677570891944 J/K) = 10.022696253560504 K, approximately +10.0 K. A temperature difference has the same numerical value in degrees Celsius.
With rounded R = 8.31 J/(mol K), Delta T = 10.028078620136382 K, also approximately +10.0 K.

conditional_conclusion.condition: 500 J denotes net work received by the gas during compression.
conditional_conclusion.reported_temperature_rise: approximately 10.0 K, equivalently a 10.0 degree Celsius increase
conditional_conclusion.absolute_final_temperature: Not determined; no initial temperature is given.

work_interpretations.interpretation: 500 J is positive work on the gas, or the magnitude of compression work.
work_interpretations.compatibility: Consistent with ordinary compression and the requested temperature rise.

work_interpretations.interpretation: 500 J is a signed positive W_by, work done by the gas.
work_interpretations.compatibility: This implies cooling, not the requested rise. Positive boundary work by the gas is inconsistent with ordinary passive compression, where dV < 0 and W_by = integral(p_external dV) < 0. It cannot silently be treated as positive work input.

work_interpretations.interpretation: 500 J describes gross compressor drive work without specifying the portion transferred to the gas.
work_interpretations.compatibility: The source supplies no loss or energy-partition data; no numerical gas temperature change follows from this interpretation alone.

invariant_vs_assumption.invariant_relation: For the stated monatomic closed ideal gas and adiabatic thermal model, Delta T = W_on/[(3/2) nu R] = -W_by/[(3/2) nu R].
invariant_vs_assumption.invariant_magnitude_when_net_gas_work_ma: |Delta T| = 10.022696253560504 K; its sign follows the work actor and sign definition.
invariant_vs_assumption.extra_assumption_for_positive_rise: Take the 500 J as net work on the gas or the magnitude of compression work. Compression and 升高 support this reading, but the phrase 做功 itself leaves the actor and signed convention unstated.
invariant_vs_assumption.not_source_repair: The alternative sign reading is recorded as a real ambiguity, not evidence of an erratum. No source text is edited.
invariant_vs_assumption.not_needed: No p-V graph, initial temperature, reversible path, constant-volume process or use of C_p is required for the conditional energy-balance calculation.

source_ambiguities: The actor of 做功 500 焦耳 and whether 500 J is signed work or a magnitude are not explicitly specified.
For a later unique signed response, the work-to-gas convention must be explicitly disclosed or clarified; this author-stage calculation does not by itself clear that condition.
